source.section: PDF page 9, Line 26 (You may not subtract: pension payments attributable to employment by an employer other than a New York public employer ... may qualify for the exclusion) and Line 29 (59 1/2 before January 1, 2025; not more than 20,000); Form IT-201 lines 26 and 29; Form IT-201 lines 19, 24, 32-39 (PDF pages 2-3); IT-201-I PDF page 11 (line 34 standard deduction table), PDF pages 12 and 33 (line 39, rate schedule)

worked: Single, 64, wages 80,000 and a New Jersey state (PERS) pension 15,000. Line 26 is only for New York State, New York local and federal pensions, so another state's pension is not subtracted in full; it is qualifying pension income for line 29 (periodic payments for services as an employee), and the person was 59 1/2 before January 1, 2025. Exclusion = lesser of 15,000 and 20,000 = 15,000. (A New York State pension of the same amount would be subtracted in full on line 26.) Federal AGI (IT-201 line 19) = 95,000.00. Federal taxable income = 95,000.00 - 15,750.00 federal standard deduction = 79,250.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored). Subtraction: line 29 pension and annuity income exclusion: New Jersey state pension 15,000, under the 20,000 limit 15,000.00. Line 32 total subtractions = 15,000.00. Line 33 New York AGI = 95,000.00 - 15,000.00 = 80,000.00. Line 34 New York standard deduction (single, PDF page 11 table) 8,000.00; line 35 = 80,000.00 - 8,000.00 = 72,000.00; line 36 dependent exemption 0 (no dependents); lines 37/38 taxable income 72,000.00. Rate schedule (PDF page 33, single) on 72,000.00: 8,500.00 x 4% = 340.00; 3,200.00 x 4.5% = 144.00; 2,200.00 x 5.25% = 115.50; 58,100.00 x 5.5% = 3,195.50; schedule tax = 3,795.00 (the printed schedule, with its whole-dollar base 600 at 13,900, gives 3,795.50; this case uses the bands as numbers). NY AGI is 107,650 or less and line 38 is 65,000 or more: the rate schedule applies (PDF page 12, line 39); no recapture worksheet. Line 39 NYS tax = 3,795.00. Credits: none (the household credit, line 40, PDF page 12 tables 1-3, allows no credit above federal AGI of 28,000 single or 32,000 other statuses): state income tax = 3,795.00.
